name: τ²-Bench Telecom
description: The telecom domain split of τ²-bench (tau2-bench), evaluating conversational agents in a dual-control Dec-POMDP environment for telecommunications troubleshooting. Both agent and user can invoke diagnostic tools, requiring explicit coordination to resolve network issues, account problems, and service configurations — a new domain not present in the original τ-bench.
evaluation_method: pass^k (task success reliability across k repeated attempts); task completion rate
general_score_metric: pass^k (task success reliability); task completion rate
typical_sota_score: Frontier models achieve 40–65% task completion; telecom introduces additional technical diagnostic reasoning compared to retail/airline
reputation: Princeton University 2025; telecom domain is new to τ²-bench (not in original τ-bench); introduces technical diagnostic reasoning alongside agent coordination in the Dec-POMDP framework
notes: arXiv:2506.07982 (2025). τ²-bench telecom is a new domain introduced alongside the dual-control Dec-POMDP framework; no equivalent exists in the original τ-bench. Tasks involve network diagnostics, account troubleshooting, and service configuration — requiring both tool-based investigation and coordinated communication with a user who also has tool access. HuggingFace: HuggingFaceH4/tau2-bench-data. Official repo: github.com/sierra-research/tau2-bench.
